description: Scaffold the monorepo structure with pnpm workspaces, configure all apps (Next.js 15 frontend, NestJS backend), shared packages (database with Prisma, shared types, UI components), and set up tooling (TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier, Turbo).
steps: Create root package.json with pnpm workspace configuration, turbo.json for task orchestration, .npmrc, .gitignore, and pnpm-workspace.yaml defining apps/* and packages/*

Create apps/web as a Next.js 15 App Router project with TypeScript, TailwindCSS v4, and the following dependencies: next@15, react@19, tailwindcss, @tailwindcss/postcss, framer-motion, zustand, @tanstack/react-query, react-hook-form, @hookform/resolvers, zod, next-auth, lucide-react, recharts, clsx, tailwind-merge, class-variance-authority

Create apps/backend as a NestJS project with dependencies: @nestjs/core, @nestjs/common, @nestjs/platform-express, @nestjs/config, @nestjs/jwt, @nestjs/passport, passport, passport-jwt, class-validator, class-transformer, @prisma/client, bcrypt, uuid, multer

Create packages/database with Prisma schema containing the full database model (users, roles, vehicles, vehicle_categories, bookings, payments, invoices, penalties, maintenance_logs, vehicle_checkpoints, documents, driver_verifications, promos, notifications, support_tickets, and all relations)
Create packages/shared with shared TypeScript types, constants (role enums, booking status enums, payment status enums), and Zod validation schemas
Create packages/ui with shadcn/ui setup - utility functions (cn helper), and base component exports
Configure root tsconfig.json with path aliases, ESLint config, Prettier config
Add root scripts: build, dev, lint, test, format, db:generate, db:push
Create .env.example files for both apps with documented environment variables
acceptance_criteria: Running pnpm install succeeds without errors
Running pnpm build compiles both apps/web and apps/backend successfully
Running pnpm --filter database prisma generate succeeds
Running pnpm --filter database prisma validate succeeds
TypeScript compilation has no errors across all packages
The Prisma schema contains all 16+ entities with proper relations
findings: Build scripts requiring Prisma need DATABASE_URL env var set (even for validate). Use pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies in root package.json to approve native builds (prisma, bcrypt, sharp). Turbo warns about no outputs for database#build since it uses echo. All 5 packages build successfully.
